hyp.code_patch:
import train
import pandas as pd
def controlled_eval(df, seed):
    groups = df[train.CAT].to_numpy()
    tr, te = train.split_idx(df, seed, groups=groups)
    tr = list(tr); te = list(te)
    y_true = df[train.TARGET].iloc[te].to_numpy()
    ytr = df[train.TARGET].iloc[tr].to_numpy()
    mapping = df.iloc[tr].groupby(train.CAT)[train.TARGET].mean()
    fallback = float(df.iloc[tr][train.TARGET].mean())
    base = [c for c in df.columns if c not in (train.TARGET, train.CAT)]
    Xtr = df[base].iloc[tr].copy()
    Xte = df[base].iloc[te].copy()
    Xtr["prior_rate"] = df.iloc[tr][train.CAT].map(mapping).fillna(fallback).to_numpy()
    Xte["prior_rate"] = df.iloc[te][train.CAT].map(mapping).fillna(fallback).to_numpy()
    y_pred = train.fit_predict(Xtr, ytr, Xte, seed)
    return (y_true, y_pred)
